title: Amos Bible Quiz - Chapter 3
description: Ten questions on Amos 3: the questions about the lion and the snare, the secret told to the prophets and the houses of ivory.

questions.text: What does God say in verse 2 follows from choosing Israel alone of all the families of the earth?
questions.explanation: Because he has only chosen them of all the families of the earth, he will punish them for all of their sins.

answers.text: He will punish them for all their sins
He will never punish them at all
He will give them all the nations
He will hide his face from them

questions.text: Verse 3 asks whether two walk together unless they have done what?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 asks: do two walk together, unless they have agreed?

questions.text: Where does verse 4 ask whether a lion will roar when he has no prey?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 asks whether a lion will roar in the thicket when he has no prey, and whether a young lion cries out of his den if he has caught nothing.

questions.text: What does verse 5 ask about a bird?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 asks whether a bird can fall in a trap on the earth where no snare is set for him.

answers.text: Whether it can fly across the wide sea
Whether it builds its nest in the cedar
Whether it can be caught with bare hands
Whether it can fall in a trap where no snare is set

questions.text: What does verse 6 say about the trumpet alarm in a city?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 asks whether the trumpet alarm sounds in a city without the people being afraid.

answers.text: The people are afraid when it sounds
No one in the city hears it
It calls the people to a feast

questions.text: To whom does the Lord Yahweh reveal his secret, according to verse 7?
questions.explanation: The Lord Yahweh will do nothing unless he reveals his secret to his servants the prophets.

questions.text: Where are those in the palaces at Ashdod and in Egypt told to assemble?
questions.explanation: They are told to assemble themselves on the mountains of Samaria and see what unrest is in her.

answers.text: In the valley of the Jordan

questions.text: What does the shepherd rescue out of the mouth of the lion, according to verse 12?
questions.explanation: As the shepherd rescues two legs or a piece of an ear out of the mouth of the lion, so shall the children of Israel be rescued.

answers.text: Two legs, or a piece of an ear

questions.text: Whose altars does God say he will visit, according to verse 14?
questions.explanation: In the day that he visits the transgressions of Israel on him, he will also visit the altars of Bethel, and the horns of the altar will be cut off.

questions.text: Which houses does verse 15 say will perish?
questions.explanation: He will strike the winter house with the summer house, the houses of ivory will perish and the great houses will have an end.
